versions.name: Camp Carruth
versions.summary: A wooded Istrouma Area Council camp near Port Allen in West Baton Rouge Parish, Louisiana, with clean campsites, hiking trails, and a covered pavilion for Cub Scout pack and Scouts BSA troop outings.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Istrouma Area Council camp page, which presents the property as both 'Camp Carruth' and 'Carruth Scout Preserve' (one property, added once). Confirmed as a current Istrouma Area Council short-term camp near Port Allen, Louisiana. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; the address lacks a house number to geocode exactly); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a weekend pack/troop-camping property; features unsurveyed.
